components.name: Indicator
components.description: Presence dot. Wrap an avatar to pin it to the bottom-right corner, or render it alone to sit inline; `showLabel` prints the status beside the dot.

examples.title: Inline with label
examples.setup:
const PEOPLE = [
  { initials: "AK", status: "online" as const },
  { initials: "MR", status: "away" as const },
  { initials: "JL", status: "busy" as const },
  { initials: "SO", status: "offline" as const },
]
examples.code: {PEOPLE.map((person) => ( ))}

examples.title: size sm, default, lg
examples.code:
<Stack direction="row" align="center" className="gap-4">
  <Indicator size="sm">
    <Avatar size="sm">AK</Avatar>
  </Indicator>
  <Indicator>
    <Avatar>AK</Avatar>
  </Indicator>
  <Indicator size="lg">
    <Avatar size="lg">AK</Avatar>
  </Indicator>
</Stack>
